runtime_claim: No claim is made that every external JANUS executable/model was invoked live. The whole-JANUS role separation is applied as a protocol and recorded for later machine execution.
primary_result: The first strong result is not a universal hidden message. It is a source-independence map: many apparent cross-scripture repetitions are pseudoreplication because books, translations, later canons and commentaries share textual ancestors or directly embed one another.

source_root_collapses.rule: Torah is part of Tanakh; much of the Christian Old Testament shares the same ancient Israelite/Jewish textual ancestry. Repetition across these labels is not independent attestation by itself.
KJV, modern English translations, Ukrainian translations, Septuagint-derived translations and other versions are translations/recensions, not automatically independent event witnesses.

Qur'anic parallels with Biblical/Jewish/Christian traditions are later textual witnesses in a historically connected cultural world. They cannot be counted as independent ancient confirmation of an earlier event without a specific independence argument.
The Bhagavad Gita is embedded within the Mahabharata textual tradition; motif recurrence between the two is not independent evidence.
The Dhammapada is part of the Khuddaka Nikaya within the Sutta Pitaka; corpus counts must not treat it as an independent canon beside the Pali Canon.
An individual sutra and the Kangyur collection containing it are nested witnesses, not independent roots.
Biblical wording inside later restoration scripture must be checked for direct textual dependence before any similarity score is treated as independent recurrence.
Multiple printed transcriptions may descend from one collector, informant, colonial edition or translation chain; number of webpages/books is not number of independent oral roots.

first_pass_findings.finding: The corpus requires a graph, not a flat bag of books.
first_pass_findings.reason: Nested canons, translations, recensions and later quotations create severe pseudoreplication.

first_pass_findings.finding: Original-language alignment is a mandatory gate for any surprising semantic parallel.
first_pass_findings.reason: English/Russian/Ukrainian translations can collapse distinct concepts into the same word or split one concept into several words.

first_pass_findings.finding: The strongest initial scientific target is historical textual transmission, not metaphysical proof.
first_pass_findings.reason: Transmission generates falsifiable predictions about date, geography, loanwords, phrase order, manuscript families and contact routes.

first_pass_findings.finding: Generic motifs such as flood, creation, law, judgment, sacred trees and moral reciprocity have low evidential specificity when used alone.
first_pass_findings.reason: They are common enough to arise through diffusion, shared environments, genre convention or independent convergence.

first_pass_findings.finding: Rare ordered bundles are more informative than theme labels.
first_pass_findings.reason: A sequence of unusual details, distinctive phrasing or shared errors can discriminate common ancestry from generic convergence better than a broad motif name.

best_next_killer_test.name: FLOOD_STEMMA_BLIND_TEST_V0_1
best_next_killer_test.question: Can TOPA separate historically connected Ancient Near Eastern flood traditions from independently convergent flood narratives using only frozen features, chronology and blinded controls?
procedure: Freeze a feature schema before looking at labels
Encode Genesis, Atrahasis, Gilgamesh XI, Qur'anic Noah passages, Manu flood text and matched non-flood controls
Collapse direct textual descendants and translations
Restore chronology/geography only after similarity scoring
Compare against shuffled and genre-matched controls
Attempt to falsify both shared-source and independent-convergence explanations
best_next_killer_test.success_condition: A reproducible separation between known/likely transmission families and independent controls without tuning on the labels.
best_next_killer_test.failure_condition: The method groups texts mainly by translation vocabulary, generic flood features or analyst-chosen labels.
best_next_killer_test.world_truth_effect: NONE; even a successful textual stemma would establish textual/historical relationships, not supernatural causation.
